name: hermes-ui-desktop
description: Hermes UI desktop app: the universal app's web build in a Tauri 2 shell, optionally with the backend as a sidecar.

scripts.web: npm --prefix ../mobile-app run web:export && rm -rf dist-web && cp -R ../mobile-app/dist-web dist-web
scripts.build: npm run web && npm run sidecar && tauri build --bundles app,dmg
